description_en: Authorizes the user and creates the threat detection and response service-linked role AliyunServiceRoleForSasCloudSiem
description_zh: 用户授权接口，点击将创建威胁分析角色AliyunServiceRoleForSasCloudSiem
name: EnableAccessForCloudSiem

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically integrate alert logs from Security Center, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Cloud Firewall. By default, the logs are automatically integrated
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动接入云安全中心、Web应用防火墙、云防火墙的告警日志，默认自动接入
parameters.name: auto_submit

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat detection and response data management center resides. Select the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: assets outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
